hook: Army re-enrolment rally at Secunderabad *tomorrow*, report 7.30 am
hook_b: Retired from EME, under 46? Army rally at 1 EME Centre *Nov 2*
tldr: Defence Security Corps holds a Sepoy (GD) re-enrolment rally for retired EME personnel at 1 EME Centre, Secunderabad, on Nov 2.

beats.what: DSC will re-enrol retired EME personnel as Sepoy (General Duty) on Monday, Nov 2.
beats.why: The Defence Security Corps recruits ex-servicemen to guard defence installations.
beats.care: Know a recently retired EME jawan? Forward this. Reporting is 7.30 am Monday.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Venue: Recruitment Cell, Headquarters, 1 EME Centre, Secunderabad. Report at 7.30 am on Nov 2. Open to EME Other Ranks retired within the last two years, not above 46 as on Oct 1, 2026. Trades: Armourer, Driver MT, Operator, Driver Recovery. Queries: 040-27863016. Number of posts was not given.

cards.title: ✅ Who can go
cards.body: Retired from Corps of EME within 2 years · max 46 years on Oct 1, 2026 · Armourer, Driver MT, Operator or Driver Recovery trade.

cards.q: Should more jobs reopen for ex-servicemen?
Where is the Nov 2 Army re-enrolment rally?
cards.why: Candidates report at the Recruitment Cell, HQ 1 EME Centre, Secunderabad, at 7.30 am.

insight: Only EME Other Ranks who retired in the last two years, aged 46 or under, can join.
watch: Posts filled and whether more DSC rallies follow.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Indian Army to hold recruitment rally for retired EME personnel in Secunderabad on November 2
